summary: Iteration 7 covered the 3 session changes end-to-end. (1) Hero perf: landing renders with img src='/hero-bg.webp', network response 200 with content-length=39762 bytes (~39KB, down from ~1.2MB PNG). Hero badge/title/CTAs/launch badge all visible; parallax + fetchPriority='high' applied; visual identity intact (navy bg, blueprint map, italic emerald 'Brain Energy' line, gold 'Emas 2045'). All 10 landing sections (problem, ecosystem, pillars, programs, roadmap, governance, news, video, publications, join) + footer render without console errors. (2) Media Gallery: admin login OK (admin@gesoi.or.id), admin-media tab renders, new media-upload-btn + hidden media-upload-input present; PNG upload via input triggered success toast 'File berhasil diunggah!' and file appeared in grid immediately (media-cards count went to 3) without navigation. (3) Adaptive Editor: pillars/programs/roadmap all show 'Tata Letak / Template' select with correct options — pillars=['list:Baris Editorial...', 'cards:Grid Kartu dengan Gambar'], programs=['grid:Kartu Ikon (klasik)','media:Kartu dengan Gambar (foto per program)'], roadmap=['timeline:Garis Waktu (teks)','photos:Garis Waktu dengan Foto']. Per-item image fields present: field-pillars-items-0-image, field-programs-items-0-image, field-roadmap-items-0-image. Ecosystem layout regression OK ['orbit','grid']. End-to-end CMS flow: set pillars.layout='cards' + pillars.items[0].image=unsplash URL → Simpan → toast 'Perubahan tersimpan!' → landing shows pillar-card-01 with image (pillar-item-01 absent). Reset pillars.layout='list' + clear image → Simpan → landing shows pillar-item-01 (pillar-card-01 absent). Backend regression: pytest 24/24 passed (auth, cms, contact). Contact POST /api/contact returned 200. After full CMS test, clicked editor-reset-btn (Konten dikembalikan ke bawaan) to restore defaults; TEST_ contacts + test upload deleted from Mongo.

minor.issue: Collection-time KeyError: reads os.environ['REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL'] without fallback; fails when env var not exported to pytest. Pre-existing from iter6, unrelated to this session but blocks CI regression run without env export.

action_items: Non-blocking: harden backend/tests/test_orders.py by using os.environ.get('REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL','...') or reading from frontend/.env at collection time so pytest doesn't error at import.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero.js line 26 uses React prop 'fetchPriority' (camelCase). React <18 warned about unknown DOM attribute; on React 18+ this is passed through as 'fetchpriority' correctly. package.json shows React 19 — OK, no warning observed in console.

editorFields.js LAYOUT_OPTIONS keys 'pillars'/'programs'/'roadmap' work because Field looks up LAYOUT_OPTIONS[path.split('-')[0]]. If path prefix ever changes (e.g. nested layout key inside items), the fallback to LAYOUT_OPTIONS.ecosystem would silently render wrong options — worth an explicit warn/whitelist.

AdminMedia.js upload button label is inside a <label> wrapping hidden <input type='file'>. Works but 'disabled' state is applied only to input, not preventing rapid double-clicks on the label; class 'pointer-events-none' during uploading mitigates this — acceptable.

IMAGE_ITEM_PATHS regex only injects an empty 'image' key for pillars-items/programs-items/roadmap-items. If backend stored content has other item arrays that should also support images later (e.g. news-items), this list has to be manually extended — consider a schema-driven approach.
